name: Reinsurance Group Of
description: Reinsurance Group of America provides life and health reinsurance to insurance companies in the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia Pacific, and trades on the NYSE.

name: Corebridge Financial
description: Corebridge Financial sells annuities, life insurance and retirement plans to individuals, employers and institutions in the US, and is an NYSE-listed company spun off from AIG in 2022.
note: Agreed all-stock merger with Equitable Holdings (announced Mar 2026, shareholders approved Jul 2026); closing expected by end-2026.

name: MPOWER Financing
description: MPOWER Financing provides student loans without cosigners or collateral to international and DACA students attending hundreds of universities in the US and Canada.

name: Grenergy
description: Grenergy is an independent power producer that builds and operates solar and battery storage plants in about 10 countries across Europe and the Americas, and is listed in Spain.

name: Zum
description: Zum provides school bus and student transportation services to US school districts, including electric bus fleets with vehicle-to-grid charging, and works with districts in about 15 states.

name: Presto
description: Presto sells voice AI systems that take drive-thru orders for quick-service restaurant chains, working with about a dozen restaurant brands across hundreds of locations.
note: Formerly Nasdaq-listed Presto Automation; delisted 2024 and assets sold to Remus Capital-led investors, now private as Presto Phoenix.

name: Equinor
description: Equinor is a majority state-owned Norwegian energy company producing oil, gas and renewable power for international markets, with over 20,000 employees and listings in Oslo and New York.

name: Victory Capitz
description: Victory Capital is a Nasdaq-listed asset manager offering mutual funds, ETFs and separately managed accounts to institutional, intermediary and retail investors, with about $340 billion under management.

name: Discovery Mining
description: Discovery Mining is a TSX-listed gold producer operating the Porcupine mining complex near Timmins, Ontario, bought from Newmont in 2025, and developing the Cordero silver project in Mexico.

name: Windward Bio
description: Windward Bio is a clinical-stage Basel biotech developing long-acting antibodies for asthma and other immune diseases, has raised about $365 million privately and filed for a Nasdaq IPO in 2026.

name: tron Mountain
description: Iron Mountain is an NYSE-listed company that stores and manages physical records and data, and operates data centers, for more than 220,000 business customers worldwide.

name: Wonderful
description: Wonderful builds AI agents that handle customer service over voice, chat and email for large enterprises in non-English markets, and raised $150 million in 2026.

name: Banco Sabade
description: Banco Sabadell is a Spanish bank serving retail, business and corporate customers mainly in Spain, and is listed in Madrid as a member of the IBEX 35 index.
note: BBVA hostile takeover bid failed (2025); sold UK unit TSB to Santander (completed 2026).

name: Fannie Mae
description: Fannie Mae is a US government-sponsored enterprise that buys and guarantees home mortgages from lenders, packaging them into securities for investors, and has been under federal conservatorship since 2008.
note: Under FHFA conservatorship since 2008; exit/privatization under discussion but not completed.

name: AutoCanada
description: AutoCanada operates about 61 franchised car dealerships across eight Canadian provinces, selling new and used vehicles, parts, service and collision repair to consumers, and is TSX-listed.

name: Red Cat
description: Red Cat Holdings makes small military reconnaissance drones, including the Black Widow chosen for the US Army's Short Range Reconnaissance program, for defense and government customers; listed on Nasdaq.

name: Scale Computing
description: Scale Computing sells hyperconverged and edge computing platforms that retailers, schools and mid-sized businesses use to run applications across many sites; founded in Indianapolis in 2008.

name: DataRobot
description: DataRobot sells a software platform that enterprises and government agencies use to build, deploy and govern machine learning models and AI agents, and is a venture-backed company based in Boston.

name: Beacon Pointe
description: Beacon Pointe Advisors is a Newport Beach-based registered investment adviser offering wealth management, institutional consulting and retirement plan services to individuals and institutions, with about $63 billion in assets.

name: Gogoro
description: Gogoro runs a battery-swapping network and sells electric scooters to riders in Taiwan, with over 2,700 swap stations and more than 650,000 riders, and is listed on Nasdaq.

name: FC Barcelona
description: FC Barcelona is a member-owned Spanish football and multi-sport club earning revenue from broadcasters, sponsors, merchandise and ticket sales, with record income of about €1.06 billion in 2025-26.

name: Saudi Energy
description: Saudi Energy, formerly Saudi Electricity Company, generates, transmits and distributes electricity to government, industrial and residential customers across Saudi Arabia, and is listed on Tadawul.

name: Alto Neuroscience
description: Alto Neuroscience is a clinical-stage biotech using EEG and other brain biomarkers to develop psychiatric drugs for depression and schizophrenia matched to likely responders; listed on the NYSE.

name: SAL
description: SAL Saudi Logistics Services handles air cargo, ground handling, warehousing and logistics for airlines and shippers at 18 Saudi airports, moving about 961,000 tons in 2025; listed on Tadawul.

name: Castelion
description: Castelion designs and manufactures hypersonic strike weapons, led by its Blackbeard missile, for the US Navy, Army, Air Force and allies, and raised a $1 billion Series C in 2026.

name: maincubes
description: maincubes builds and operates data centers in Frankfurt, Berlin and Amsterdam for cloud and AI providers, enterprises and public-sector clients, with over 400 MW operating or under development.

name: Platform Accounting Group
note: could not identify (web search budget exhausted; company website returned 403)

name: Bancomext
description: Bancomext is Mexico's state-owned development bank for foreign trade, providing credit and financial services to Mexican exporters and companies in export supply chains since 1937.

name: Commercial Bank Of Qatar
description: Commercial Bank of Qatar is a Doha-based bank, founded in 1975, offering retail, corporate, wealth management and investment banking services in Qatar, and is listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange.

name: Totalplay
description: Totalplay, part of Grupo Salinas, sells fiber-optic internet, pay TV and fixed phone bundles to households and businesses across 26 Mexican states and Mexico City.

name: Six Flags
description: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation operates amusement and water parks and resorts in North America for families and tourists, with about 34 properties, and is listed on the NYSE.
note: Merged with Cedar Fair (Jul 2024); sold seven parks to EPR Properties (2026).

name: Pan American Energy
description: Pan American Energy Corp. is an exploration-stage mining company acquiring and exploring battery-metal properties, including the Big Mack lithium project in northwestern Ontario, and is listed on the CSE.

name: Bristol-Myers Squibb
description: Bristol Myers Squibb is an NYSE-listed pharmaceutical company selling cancer, cardiovascular, immunology and other prescription drugs such as Eliquis and Opdivo worldwide, with about $48 billion in 2025 revenue.

name: Nexstar Media Group
description: Nexstar Media Group is the largest US local television station owner, also controlling The CW, NewsNation and The Hill, earning from advertisers and pay-TV distributors, with about 18,500 employees.
note: Acquired Tegna ($6.2B; DOJ/FCC approved Mar 2026); state and DirecTV antitrust suits led to a court order restricting integration.

name: Brown University
description: Brown University is a private Ivy League research university in Providence, Rhode Island, founded in 1764, enrolling about 11,000 students with an endowment of roughly $9.5 billion.

name: ACWA Power
description: Acwa, formerly ACWA Power, develops and operates power, desalination and green hydrogen plants that sell electricity and water to state utilities in 14 countries; listed on Tadawul.
note: Rebranded from ACWA Power to Acwa (Jan 2026).

name: AMAG Pharmaceuticals
description: AMAG Pharmaceuticals is a US drug company best known for Feraheme, an intravenous iron treatment for adults with iron deficiency anemia, and has been a Covis Group subsidiary since 2020.
note: Acquired by Covis Group (Nov 2020, about $498M); delisted from Nasdaq.

name: Nakamoto
description: Nakamoto is a Nasdaq-listed bitcoin company that holds bitcoin on its balance sheet and runs Bitcoin media (BTC Inc.), asset management (UTXO Management) and advisory businesses.
note: Successor to KindlyMD after its 2025 merger with Nakamoto Holdings; trades as NAKA.

name: Wabtec
description: Wabtec makes locomotives, braking systems and other equipment and services for freight railroads and passenger transit operators worldwide, with about 29,500 employees and an NYSE listing.

name: UL Solutions
description: UL Solutions provides product safety testing, inspection and certification services and compliance software to manufacturers and businesses in more than 110 countries, and is listed on the NYSE.

name: Princeton Digital Group
description: Princeton Digital Group develops and operates hyperscale data centers for cloud and AI customers across seven Asia Pacific markets including Singapore, Japan, India and Indonesia.

name: ProducePay
description: ProducePay offers pre-season financing, quick payment and supply chain tools to fresh produce growers and buyers in more than 20 countries, and has over 300 employees.

name: Vestwell
description: Vestwell runs a retirement and education savings platform used by employers, financial advisors, institutions and state-run programs, serving over 2.75 million savers with more than $57 billion in assets.

name: Copia Power
description: Copia Power develops and operates US solar, battery storage and thermal power campuses serving utilities, cooperatives, municipalities and corporations, with about 750 MW operating and over 30 GW in development.

name: Rakuten Medical
description: Rakuten Medical develops cancer treatments based on its Alluminox photoimmunotherapy platform, with a drug approved in Japan for head and neck cancer and operations in the US, Japan and Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manu
description: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing chips for Nvidia, Apple, AMD and other designers, with about 70% foundry market share and listings in Taipei and New York.

name: Allegiant Travel
description: Allegiant Travel runs Allegiant Air, a low-cost airline flying leisure travelers from small and mid-sized US cities to vacation destinations, plus travel packages, and is listed on Nasdaq.
note: Acquired Sun Country Airlines (about $1.5B, closed May 2026).

name: Planet Fitness
description: Planet Fitness franchises and operates low-cost gyms aimed at casual and first-time exercisers, with about 2,700 clubs in the US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Spain and Australia; NYSE-listed.

name: CHIP Reverse Mortgage
description: HomeEquity Bank, a Canadian chartered bank owned by Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, offers CHIP reverse mortgages to homeowners aged 55 and over, with a portfolio above CA$5 billion.

name: Taylor Morrison
description: Taylor Morrison builds and sells new homes, from entry-level to resort-style communities, to homebuyers in 12 US states, and since July 2026 is owned by Berkshire Hathaway.
note: Acquired by Berkshire Hathaway for $8.5B in cash (announced May 2026, closed Jul 2026).
